question.prompt: The side lengths of five triangles are: (1) 3, 3, 3; (2) 3, 3, 4; (3) 5, 5, 5; (4) 2, 3, 4; (5) 6, 6, 6. How many of these are equilateral triangles?

solutions.explanation: An equilateral triangle has three equal sides. These are (1), (3), and (5), giving a total of 3.
solutions.title: Check for three equal sides
